_comment: Splat FILE units -> Vicon metres, as p_splat = scale * (R @ p_vicon) + t. Since 2026-10-23 this bundle is stored in the Vicon frame itself (captures/tools/level_bundle.py), so R is the identity and t is zero: scene metres ARE Vicon metres, and z is up. levelling.json holds the COLMAP-frame transform this replaced, which is what made_from describes.
